card.name: Words just before study or effect terms
card.fires_on: Mid-phrase words in drug-label sentences that come right before a noun like studies, effects or drugs, such as 'clinical', 'controlled', 'desired effect' and 'other CNS'. It also fires inside a few long words like adrenergic and pharmacokinetics.

modes.label: Modifier before studies
modes.description: An adjective such as clinical or controlled just before the word studies.
modes.example: The incidence of renal failure in<< clinical>> studies in which patients received pemetrex

modes.label: Desired effect / other drugs
modes.description: A noun or modifier that sits in the middle of a phrase and is followed by of or by a drug class.
modes.example: to determine if the desired<< effect>> of the diuretic is obtained.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long technical word.
